clips.note: They say a science idea: “super asymmetry”. Someone asks if it is real. The answer: no, they are making it up right now.
One cook talks about learning from your mistakes. The other is surprised: is that a real, known idea? “Yeah.”
around: but learning from them and not seeing them as failures?

clips.note: An American is taking a British driving test. One answer says the car “stalls”. He isn’t sure that really happens, so he asks.
around: pedal down or roll in neutral for too long?
It will cause the engine to overheat.

clips.line: Dish detergent. Is that a thing? I don’t even know
clips.note: He isn’t sure “dish detergent” is a real, normal thing. He really doesn’t know.

clips.line: I’m like 28, with knee-high socks, is that a thing?
clips.note: The speaker is 28 and wears knee-high socks. Is that normal for adults? Do other people do it too?
